gaps.explanation: p7 Statement of Revenues, Expenses, and Changes in Net Position - Proprietary Funds prints Electric Fund, Water Fund, Solid Waste Fund and Sewer Fund columns; no utility schedule is in the trim, so detail has no business-type lines. JSON receipts = Sales + Other revenue + Interest income + Grant income. Per column: Electric 671,150 + 4,767 + 344 + 487 = 676,748; Water 198,875 + 7,043 + 274 + 47,344 = 253,536; Solid Waste 171,596 + 10,864 + 15,884 = 198,344; Sewer 60,356 + 902 + 54 = 61,312. 0 + 676,748 + 253,536 + 198,344 + 61,312 = 1,189,940 = statement total.
